# Introduction

#### Course: Practice: Java Intermediate

## Introduction

Welcome to Practice: Java Intermediate!

This is a complementary course created to work hand-in-hand with our Learn Java Intermediate course. Use this course to practice your understanding of intermediate Java concepts.

Each chapter in this course includes practice problems that correspond to the concepts covered in Learn Java Intermediate.

![Idea Emoji](data:image/png;base64,)

![Learn Java Intermediate  Course](data:image/png;base64,)

Whenever you are stuck on any practice problems, simply revisit the corresponding chapter of Learn Java Intermediate and try the problem again.

This course helps you solidify your understanding and build confidence in your Java skills.

Let's get started.

##### How does it work?

Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
